rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a thought, notion, or way of thinking.
Use this when the idea is a plan or intention for what to do.

example.english: How about we reschedule—is that a good idea?
example.traditional: 不如我哋改期，呢個主意好唔好呀？
example.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 goi2 kei4 ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a mental picture or image of a person or thing, rather than a thought or plan.

example.english: I still have an idea of what the house I lived in as a child looked like.
example.traditional: 我腦入面仲有細個住嗰間屋嘅形象。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nou5 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 sai3 go3 zyu6 go2 gaan1 uk1 ge3 jing4 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this when the idea is an intuitive hunch or impression rather than a reasoned thought.

example.english: The moment I saw him, I got the idea that something was off.
example.traditional: 我一見到佢，就有種唔對路嘅直覺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 zau6 jau5 zung2 m4 deoi3 lou6 ge3 zik6 gok3
